race.comment: TOP RICH (4) stepped up to this trip at Ballarat and ran an improved race, working home well into second. Fitter again, just not sure where he gets to from the draw but with any luck he'll be very hard to beat. PRIME FORCE (11) has shown ability in two runs to date, perhaps not loving the synthetic last time. Gear changes made, he can improve again. LEVENT (10) was okay at Seymour latest but the run prior at Kilmore reads well for this when bumping into a handy one. TRENTINO (5) can mix his form a bit but has claims on the run at Geelong while LATE NIGHT WONDER (9) ran in a very hot maiden on debut and can improve despite the big margin defeat.
